label: NCBI genome assembly UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0 (GCF_011100685.1), Canis lupus familiaris
bibliographic_citation: Uppsala University (2020-03-10). Canis lupus familiaris genome assembly UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0, accession GCF_011100685.1. NCBI Datasets.
license: NCBI data are not subject to copyright and are in the public domain (NCBI Website and Data Usage Policies)

distributions.description: NCBI Datasets v2 genome dataset report (metadata) for the taxon, reference assembly only
same dataset report queried via the domestic-dog taxid 9615 (Canis lupus familiaris); returns the same assembly
full assembly data package (sequence + annotation); not downloaded

counts.description: total assembled sequence length in base pairs (assembly_stats.total_sequence_length)
annotated genes (NCBI Canis lupus familiaris Annotation Release 106)

measurement_technique: Whole-genome shotgun sequencing and assembly (German Shepherd Mischka); assembly level Chromosome; source database SOURCE_DATABASE_REFSEQ; the RefSeq reference assembly returned for both NCBI taxid 9612 (Canis lupus) and 9615 (Canis lupus familiaris).
role: reference genome assembly for the domestic dog (Canis familiaris) and, by NCBI designation, for the species Canis lupus as a whole; no separate wild-wolf reference is flagged by NCBI
